answer: A juniper stake roots the newcomer to one spot. They lock a $150 bond and register one hardware key, then finish 16 real client jobs in 45 days, each result pinned to a public karst ledger anyone can re-run. Four random established peers audit six jobs; pass 14 of 16 and the bond returns, one forged job burns the $150 and bans the key 90 days. The knoll stays visible: every job and every failure is public. A thousand fakes need $150,000 in bonds, 16,000 real jobs, about 4,000 hours. Like a juniper on a bare knoll, a real identity grows slowly in the open and a fake has nowhere to hide.
